fields.PRODUCT NAME: Brass Goddess Lakshmi Idol – Seated on Lotus
fields.DESCRIPTION: Invite wealth, prosperity, and harmony into your home with this beautifully handcrafted Brass Goddess Lakshmi Idol. Depicted seated gracefully on a lotus and holding lotus flowers, Goddess Lakshmi radiates divine energy and blessings of abundance, purity, and good fortune. The intricate detailing and antique golden finish make it a perfect addition to your pooja room, meditation altar, or as an auspicious gift for loved ones during festivals and special occasions.
